The '''Cobaltia Sea''' was a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was renowned in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] for its warm waters and light winds, and was one of the locations that the [[Alderaanian tourist board]] put forward in its advertisements. The Cobaltia Sea was destroyed along with the whole planet when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used its new [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] on Alderaan in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
